top_choice_rationale: Optical lattice clocks to Katori and Ye is a mature, independently reproduced capability (magic-wavelength trapping cancelling Doppler, recoil and light shifts, reaching about 1e-18) that is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes; the two-name allocation matches the concept and the first realisation plus the frontier-accuracy development, and the citation is scoped to the lattice rather than clocks in general. Nature has been shown a measurement regime that did not exist before, and I prefer awarding this established achievement to no award.
